title: 28 May 1969: Mixing, master compilation: Let It Be, Get Back album
content:
Studio One, Olympic Sound Studios, London
Producer: George Martin
Engineer: Glyn Johns

This session saw the creation of a stereo mix for the song ‘Let It Be’, and the compilation of the master tape for Glyn Johns’ unreleased Get Back album.

Johns had worked for a number of days on the album, without much involvement from The Beatles, and this day saw the completion of his work.

The tracklisting for Get Back was as follows, with the dates from January 1969 when the takes were recorded in brackets.

  • ‘One After 909’ (30 January)
  • ‘I’m Ready’ (22)
  • ‘Save The Last Dance For Me’ (22)
  • ‘Don’t Let Me Down’ (22)
  • ‘Dig A Pony’ (23)
  • ‘I’ve Got A Feeling’ (22)
  • ‘Get Back’ (single edit; 27/28)
  • ‘For You Blue’ (25)
  • ‘Teddy Boy’ (24)
  • ‘Two Of Us’ (24)
  • ‘Maggie Mae’ (24)
  • ‘Dig It’ (24)
  • ‘Let It Be’ (31)
  • ‘The Long And Winding Road’ (26)
  • ‘Get Back’ (reprise; 28)
Page last updated: 7 July 2022
